Aisha / team —

Thanks for the demos last week. We're aligned on the evaluation goals but Procurement has asked for a clear go/no-go schedule and an itemized list of approvals so they can plan the PO timing on their side. Two specific asks from our end:

1) Can you confirm the final signatory (name/title) on the Redwood side and any internal approvals that must happen before DocuSign?
2) We need a mutually-agreed start date for services and an outline of the evaluation milestones leading up to the go/no-go decision.

Procurement flagged that they typically require a 10 business day lead time from PO issuance to onboarding; if we aim to start in early January they need to receive the PO by mid-December. Can you advise?

Also please send the latest MAP and the SOW redlines. Procurement wants the signature matrix too.

Thanks,

- Legal review complete: by 2026-12-10 (Redwood legal + BrightLayer legal exchange redlines)
- Procurement PO submitted: target 2026-12-17 (BrightLayer)

Approvals path (proposed):
- Redwood: Sales (Aisha) -> Sales Manager (Rishi) -> Legal -> VP Sales (exec sign-off)
- BrightLayer: Procurement -> Legal -> VP Product / Platform (exec sign-off)

Quick notes:

- We can support a short pilot window starting earlier if you want to run a two-week technical validation prior to contract execution — we'd treat that as a scoped eval with a statement of intent (not a full production start).

DocuSign link will be created once Legal confirms the final SOW. Marcus — if you can confirm the SOW redlines status and whether SRE needs a separate MSA clause on log retention, please reply.

Hi all —

Adding Customer Success perspective and a short evaluation plan so execs have visibility:

Evaluation plan (scoped for MAP):
- Success criteria: average token latency < 150ms P50 for 1k-5k prompt batch sizes; embedding recall > 92% on internal test set; throughput >= 200 reqs/min with configured batcher.
- Milestones:
  * 12/20: pilot start (technical validation) — 2 weeks, limited users
  * 01/04: formal onboarding (post-signature) — full tenant provisioning
  * 01/18: evaluation close & go/no-go call (metrics + exec decision)

I'll maintain the shared evaluation tracker here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aB-rightlink-MAP-tracking (sheet: Eval Criteria). I've attached a compact evaluation checklist (eval-criteria.xlsx).

Go/no-go meeting options: Dec 22 (if PO + e-sign by Dec 20) OR Jan 18 (if we follow Jan 4 start). Please confirm preferred meeting organizers.

Notes on risk:
- If procurement timeline slips past Dec 17, the pre-holiday engineering freeze may push onboarding into mid-Jan, which would impact BrightLayer's Q1 reporting.
- For the pilot we will provide isolated capacity and a pre-wired KV cache config; we'll need a preliminary dataset and 2 technical contacts from BrightLayer.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
